title: dsh: comment markers between patch-list entries are dropped on rewrite, breaking comment-delimited managed blocks (Vibe Island)
head: 91a19f2568f5d7d504a3ca11c97ea027294b04ca
unverifiedBoundaries: No real DeepSeek Harness on the reporter's macOS; the round that drops the comment was run through dshRouteAgain on the reporter's literal file.
A comment indented inside an entry magpie rebuilds is still the entry's and is not preserved; the issue and this fix cover comments at the left edge between entries.
